rationale: One critical runtime bug found: WorkflowConfig.update() does not accept yaml_config as a kwarg, so the rollback mutates history but silently drops the config change — every rollback call will either raise TypeError or no-op depending on SQLModel's **kwargs handling. Tests pass only because the workflow fixture is MagicMock. Fix is a one-liner. All other findings are deferred.

business_review.criterion: GET /v1/workflows/{id}/versions returns revision list with total_revisions, workflow_name, workflow_id
POST /v1/workflows/{id}/versions/rollback rolls back to target revision using revision_index
business_review.notes: Implementation calls workflow.update(yaml_config=...) which raises TypeError at runtime — yaml_config is not a parameter of WorkflowConfig.update(). The rollback never applies the target yaml_config.

business_review.criterion: Rollback prepends current config as new audit history entry (immutable-append)
Auth: READ for list, WRITE for rollback
business_review.notes: Action.READ on GET, Action.WRITE on POST rollback; raise_access_denied when denied.

business_review.criterion: 400 on empty history, 400 on out-of-range index
business_review.notes: Both guard clauses present with informative messages.

standards_review.notes: Both commits follow EPMCDME-####: Description. Range: EPMCDME-8827_workflow-versioning-clean..HEAD.
Apache 2.0 header present on all 4 new/modified files.

workflow_version_service.py uses typing.Optional[str] instead of str | None and lacks from __future__ import annotations. Code quality guide prefers the modern form. Not blocking — make ruff will flag if ruff UP007 is enabled.
No secrets, no injection surface, no unsafe file/process handling introduced.

findings.summary: workflow.update(yaml_config=...) raises TypeError — yaml_config is not a valid kwarg
findings.problem: WorkflowVersionService.rollback_to_version calls workflow.update(yaml_config=target.yaml_config, yaml_config_history=new_history) at line 72 of workflow_version_service.py. WorkflowConfig.update() accepts only (refresh, validate, yaml_config_history) — it does not accept yaml_config. This raises TypeError at runtime on every rollback call.
findings.impact: Every POST /v1/workflows/{id}/versions/rollback call with a real WorkflowConfig object crashes with TypeError. Tests pass only because the workflow fixture is MagicMock which accepts arbitrary kwargs. The acceptance criterion 'rollback to specific revision' is not met.
findings.recommendation:
Set workflow.yaml_config = target.yaml_config directly on the object before calling update(), matching the pattern in workflow_service.py lines 650-684. Change line 72 from:
  workflow.update(yaml_config=target.yaml_config, yaml_config_history=new_history)
to:
  workflow.yaml_config = target.yaml_config
  workflow.update(yaml_config_history=new_history)
Also update the test at line 131-133 which currently asserts yaml_config in call_kwargs — after the fix, update() will no longer receive yaml_config as a kwarg; instead assert workflow.yaml_config == 'old: yaml' directly on the mock after the call.
